decisions.label: Biospecimen
decisions.description: Any material sample taken from a biological entity for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes, including a sample obtained from a living organism or taken from the biological object after halting of all its life functions.

verification.note: NCIT:C70699 represents the biospecimen entity concept; the row is a metadata schema node, but this is the canonical reference term for the biospecimen domain.

decisions.label: Specimen Identifier
decisions.description: A unique string of characters used to identify a specimen.

verification.note: NCIT:C166393 exactly matches a unique specimen identifier. Existing description adds format-specific detail (ModelKey-Bxxx pattern).

decisions.label: Biospecimen Type
decisions.description: The type of a material sample taken from a biological entity for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for 'Biospecimen Type Category'. NCIT:C70713 'Biospecimen Type' is the closest available. This field represents a higher-level grouping (e.g., Tissue, Blood, Fluid) rather than the fine-grained type. Human review recommended.

decisions.label: Biospecimen Type
decisions.description: The type of a material sample taken from a biological entity for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes.

verification.note: NCIT:C70713 label and definition match exactly. Existing description 'The type of biospecimen' is consistent.

decisions.label: Sex
decisions.description: The biological sex designation of an individual based on reproductive anatomy, chromosomes, hormones, and related characteristics.

verification.note: NCIT:C28421 'Sex' captures biological sex of specimen donor. Existing description 'Biological sex associated with the specimen donor' is consistent with the NCIT definition.

decisions.label: Age at Specimen Collection
decisions.description: Age of a subject when a specimen was collected.

verification.note: NCIT:C202854 exactly matches. Existing description adds instruction about the unit field.

decisions.label: Histologic Subtype
decisions.description: The classification of tumors based on their histology.

verification.note: NCIT:C19790 'Histologic Subtype' is the closest available match. The existing description is more verbose and mentions ICD-O framing; histologic subtype covers the core concept. Human review recommended.

decisions.label: Histologic Grade
decisions.description: The degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation, the extent to which cancer cells are similar in appearance and function to healthy cells of the same tissue type.

verification.note: NCIT:C18000 'Histologic Grade' closely matches. Existing description 'Numeric value to express the degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation and aggressiveness' is consistent.

decisions.label: Specimen Anatomic Site
decisions.description: The anatomic site from which a biospecimen was obtained.

verification.note: NCIT:C171435 matches exactly. Existing description frames it as the primary disease site, which is a common proxy for collection site.

decisions.term: Biospecimen Site of Resection or Biopsy
decisions.label: Site of Resection or Biopsy
decisions.description: The anatomic site from which a biopsy sample, or other tissue, was removed.

verification.note: NCIT:C156421 label and definition match exactly.

decisions.label: Primary Site of Disease
decisions.description: The anatomic location where a disease of interest originated.

verification.note: NCIT:C158874 'Primary Site of Disease' aligns with the spirit of site of origin of malignant disease. The NCIT term is classified as a Record/Description rather than a Property; human review recommended.

decisions.label: Timepoint Event Category
decisions.description: The classification or description of an event observed or recorded during a clinical encounter where a treatment is administered, a sample is collected for laboratory or molecular analysis, or follow-up information is gathered.

verification.note: NCIT:C198201 aligns well with the field's purpose of labeling clinical events (Baseline, End of Treatment, etc.) associated with specimen collection.

decisions.label: Pharmacologic Substance
decisions.description: Any natural, endogenously-derived, synthetic or semi-synthetic compound with pharmacologic activity used to prevent, diagnose, treat, or relieve symptoms of a disease.

verification.note: NCIT:C1909 'Pharmacologic Substance' represents the concept of a therapeutic agent/drug. The field records text identification of agents used in a treatment regimen. No more specific 'Therapeutic Agent name' property term was found in NCIT. Human review recommended.

decisions.label: Histology ICD-O Morphology Code
decisions.description: Codes for the histologic type of the tumor being reported using ICD-O.

verification.note: NCIT:C176985 exactly matches the ICD-O morphology coding concept described in the existing description.

decisions.label: Fixative
decisions.description: A compound that preserves tissues and cells for microscopic study.

verification.note: NCIT:C498 definition 'A compound that preserves tissues and cells for microscopic study' matches existing description exactly.

decisions.label: BioSample Accession Number
decisions.description: An alphanumeric identifier assigned to biological materials submitted to NCBI archives, used to generate or associate data.

verification.note: NCIT:C175889 'BioSample Accession Number' matches exactly — the existing description specifies SAMN accession numbers for NCBI BioSample.

decisions.label: Staining Method
decisions.description: A method that uses dye, reagent, or other material to produce coloration in tissues or microorganisms for microscopic examination.

verification.note: NCIT:C23010 'Staining Method' is a procedure class. The field records the name of the stain used (a method identifier), so this is a reasonable match at the method concept level. Human review recommended.

decisions.label: Last Known Disease Status
decisions.description: The most recently documented condition or state with regards to a disease of interest.

verification.note: NCIT:C191938 label and definition exactly match the field purpose.

decisions.label: Site of Metastasis
decisions.description: The anatomical location where metastasis was detected.

verification.note: NCIT:C172233 matches the concept. The field allows multiple values (comma-separated), while NCIT:C172233 is singular; the semantics align.

decisions.label: Primary Tumor Site
decisions.description: The anatomic location of a primary tumor.

verification.note: NCIT:C179451 matches. Existing description 'Primary site in the body associated with the primary diagnosis' is consistent.

decisions.label: Disease Response
decisions.description: The molecular/pathological and/or clinical changes that result from treatment, including eradication of detectable disease, stabilization of disease, or disease progression.

verification.note: NCIT:C50995 aligns well. The existing description frames it as treatment response of a model/patient from which the specimen was derived, consistent with the concept.
